improvements.description: Rotar secrets críticos y prevenir exposición en repo
improvements.codeChange:
# .gitignore additions
.env
serviceAccountKey.json
*.pem
*.key

# .env.example template (commit this instead)
JWT_SECRET=your_secure_random_string_here
SMTP_PASS=your_smtp_password
FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH=./serviceAccountKey.json

# Generate new secrets:
# node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"
improvements.lesson: NUNCA committear secrets reales. Usar .env.example como template. Rotar inmediatamente si se filtra.

improvements.description: Eliminar artefactos y archivos temporales del repo
improvements.codeChange:
# .gitignore additions
backup/
temp_*.cjs
temp_*.mjs
temp_*.js
*.log
server.stdout.log
server.stderr.log
graph.html
fluxograma.html
node_modules/
.env
*.sqlite
*.sqlite-*

# Remover del historial si ya committeado:
# git rm -r --cached backup/
# git rm --cached temp_*.cjs graph.html
improvements.lesson: NUNCA committear build artifacts, temp files, logs, o archivos generados. Configurar .gitignore ANTES del primer commit.

improvements.description: Configurar ESLint + Prettier + TypeScript + Husky pre-commit
improvements.lesson: Configurar tooling ANTES de escribir código. Husky pre-commit evita commits rotos. TypeScript catcha bugs en dev.

improvements.description: Dividir archivos monolíticos > 1000 líneas en módulos
improvements.codeChange:
# app.js split proposal
js/app/
  index.js          # Orquestador principal (200 lines)
  ui/
    tabs.js         # Navegación tabs
    modals.js       # Modales
    notifications.js # Toasts
  features/
    import.js       # Carga archivos
    validate.js     # Validación SNC
    export.js       # Exportación
    municipal.js    # Validación municipal
    cogo.js         # COGO
    map.js          # Leaflet wrapper
  core/
    state.js        # Estado global
    events.js       # Event bus

# server-api.js split
server/
  index.js          # Express setup (100 lines)
  routes/
    auth.js         # /api/auth/*
    projects.js     # /api/projects/*
    expedientes.js  # /api/expedientes/*
    payments.js     # /api/payments/*
    validation.js   # /api/validation/*
    admin.js        # /api/admin/*
  middleware/
    auth.js         # JWT + Firebase
    rateLimit.js    # Rate limiting
    sanitize.js     # Input sanitization
  db/
    sqlite.js       # SQLite wrapper
    firestore.js    # Firestore wrapper
improvements.lesson: Regla: max 500 líneas por archivo. Single Responsibility. Feature-based folder structure. Barrel exports.

improvements.description: Configurar Vite para bundling, tree-shaking y producción
improvements.lesson: CDN en producción = SPOF, lentitud, CSP issues. Bundler = tree-shaking, code-splitting, cache busting, CSP compliant.

improvements.description: Integrar PostGIS real para validación municipal completa
improvements.codeChange:
# docker-compose.yml para PostGIS
services:
  postgis:
    image: postgis/postgis:16-3.4
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: snc_municipal
      POSTGRES_USER: snc
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - postgis_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./sql/init:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"

# sql/init/01_schema.sql
CREATE EXTENSION postgis;
CREATE TABLE parcelas_oficiales (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  padron VARCHAR(20),
  geom GEOMETRY(Polygon, 32721),
  INDEX idx_geom USING GIST (geom)
);
CREATE TABLE hidrografia_mades (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  nombre VARCHAR(100),
  tipo VARCHAR(20),
  geom GEOMETRY(MultiLineString, 32721),
  INDEX idx_geom USING GIST (geom)
);

# server-api.js - habilitar PostGIS
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const pgPool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });
export const postgis = { query: (sql, params) => pgPool.query(sql, params) };
improvements.lesson: Stubs no sustituyen motor espacial real. PostGIS = índices GiST, ST_Intersects, ST_DWithin, ST_Buffer nativos. Es requisito legal para validación municipal.

patterns.pattern: Secrets (JWT, SMTP, Firebase keys) committeados al repo
patterns.prevention: Add to .gitignore: .env, serviceAccountKey.json. Use .env.example template. Rotate immediately if leaked.

patterns.pattern: Archivos de backup y temporales committeados al repo
patterns.prevention: Add to .gitignore: backup/, temp_*.cjs, *.log, graph.html. Configure .gitignore BEFORE first commit.
ESLint rule max-lines: 500. Split into feature modules. Single Responsibility Principle.

patterns.pattern: Sin bundler en producción - scripts CDN en HTML
patterns.prevention: Add Vite/Webpack. Build para producción. Self-host deps críticas. Tree-shaking + code-splitting.

patterns.pattern: Sin linting ni type checking en CI
examples: No .eslintrc, no tsconfig, no pre-commit hooks
patterns.prevention: Add ESLint + Prettier + TypeScript + Husky pre-commit. CI gate: lint + typecheck + test.
npm audit fix en CI. Dependency review en PRs. Dependabot alerts. pin versions.
